06:22 SGTInvesting
BREAKING: US margin debt jumped +$26 billion in September, to $1.48 trillion, the 2nd-highest level on record.

Since the start of 2026, margin debt has surged +$255 billion, or +21%.

As a % of GDP, this metric is up to a record 4.5%, surpassing the previous peak of 3.6% set in 2021.

At the same time, the margin debt-to-M2 money supply ratio is up to 6.3%, the 3rd-highest level on record.

By comparison, this ratio peaked at 6.4% during the 2000 Dot-Com Bubble.

Leveraged investing has never been more popular.

By comparison, before the 2020 pandemic, daily volumes ranged between $100 billion and $500 billion.

Investors aggressively bought puts into Friday's close.

The S&P 500 has recorded 124 all-time highs since the current bull market began on October 12th, 2022.

Over this period, the index has rallied +118%, entering the 5th year of its bull market.

This year alone, the index has posted 28 all-time highs, after 39 and 57 in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

By comparison, the S&P 500 recorded 70 all-time highs in 2021 and 33 in 2020.

Meanwhile, more than 1,003 trading days have passed since the S&P 500 last recorded a new 52-week low, marking the 6th-longest such streak in history.

For perspective, such a streak lasted 2,556 days between 1990 and 2000, ending on November 21st.

The market is experiencing a historic bull run.

BREAKING: Japanese banks sold -$16 billion of foreign bonds in September, their largest monthly sale since February.

This also marks their 9th consecutive monthly sale, the longest streak since 2022.

As a result, sales of foreign debt by Japanese banks in the first 9 months of 2026 were the largest for that period since 2005.

Japanese financial institutions have turned to domestic government bonds, whose yields have surged to their highest levels in 3 decades.

Over the 5 months ending in August, large banks and insurers bought +$34 billion of Japanese government bonds with maturities of 2 years or more, their largest 5-month purchase since the start of 2023.

Global bond demand is undergoing a historic shift as yields rise.

Maven is the backbone of NATO’s Eastern Flank Deterrence Initiative:

“Command posts utilized next-generation command-and-control software, including the Maven Smart System, to establish a unified common operating picture across dispersed national headquarters. This common data backbone enabled military planners to process vast amounts of operational data, accelerate commander decision cycles and coordinate deep fires across the land, air, sea, cyber and space domains.”

“Conducted from Oct. 6 to 15, the exercise brought together approximately 2,000 U.S. service members and 2,000 multinational personnel operating from command posts across France, Germany, the Netherlands and Poland. Avenger Triad 26 was synchronized with NATO’s premier command post exercise, Steadfast Duel 26, which linked strategic and operational decision-makers across all 32 Allied nations.”

“A central objective of the exercise was putting concepts from NATO’s Eastern Flank Deterrence Initiative into operational practice. Rather than relying solely on static lines of defense, EFDI integrates advanced sensors, unmanned aerial systems, cloud computing and shared data environments to shorten the time between threat detection and target engagement.”

“Last year we finished at a high level, and this year we started at that level,” Lowin said. “The credibility of our deterrence rests on our capability. When an adversary sees that 32 nations can share data seamlessly, command corps-level formations across thousands of kilometers and coordinate joint fires in minutes, it sends an unmistakable signal: attacking NATO will not succeed.”

Global smartphone purchases have collapsed.

Worldwide smartphone shipments dropped -22.0% YoY in Q3 2026, to 255.3 million units, their largest quarterly decline on record.

Samsung's shipments fell -5.8% YoY, to 57.8 million units, while Apple's declined -4.0% to 57.3 million units.

At the same time, Xiaomi shipments fell -29.2% YoY to 30.7 million units, Oppo dropped -34.5%, to 25.6 million units, while Vivo fell -31.5%, to 19.1 million units.

This comes as memory costs have surged +350% since last year, driven by AI-related demand, putting further pressure on smartphone manufacturers.

As a result, soaring component costs are forcing vendors to raise prices and reduce budget-focused offerings, with consumers increasingly keeping their existing devices for longer.

Global smartphone sales are contracting amid surging prices.

Andrew Moss, CMT@Andy__Moss
02:41 SGTInvesting
It’s about balance and being able to let the trade work.

Pyramiding is great. It’s also harder to do as it has a tendency to magnify discomfort.

If you can take full size, let the trade breathe, and watch it play out till the end, fantastic! Bigger for longer is obviously optimal for trades that are working.

But, if you get antsy when it starts to pullback, thinking about giving back profits, then trimming and trailing is a great method for alleviating that.

Like everything in trading it takes intense discipline. And that’s after you test different methods to find out what suits your mentality best.

Trading around a core is also a good approach. I have no problem adding back to a position if it sets up again with good r/r.
